description: NFT holdings, metadata, and collection data across supported chains.
limitations: Read-only NFT data. Not a wallet and not an order book.
setup_hint: Connect with an Alchemy API key.

tools.name: holdings
tools.description: NFTs currently owned by an address. Pass owner and optional chain, contract, page_key. Chains: ethereum, polygon, base, arbitrum, bsc, optimism, ink, robinhood, solana. Default ethereum.

tools.name: nft
tools.description: One NFT. On EVM pass contract and token_id. On solana pass the mint as contract.

tools.name: collection
tools.description: Collection metadata and floor. Pass contract, or a Solana collection mint.
